description:
Access all the tools you need for data analysis with our comprehensive solution. Start shifting your focus from data to discovery and take advantage of NGS workflows, interpretation and visualization.


QIAGEN CLC Genomics Workbench 26.0.5
Bug fixes
- Fixed an issue where double-clicking an annotation in the circular view of a sequence selected all symbols instead of just those overlapping the annotation.
- Fixed an issue causing workflows to look pixelated in the Workflow Editor canvas and the Minimap in the Side Panel when using a scaled monitor (e.g. an HiDPI monitor).
- Fixed an issue where QDI Licensing could not be used if the Workbench was configured to use a proxy that requires authentication.
- Various minor bug fixes
- Vulnerabilities fixed in this release include:
  - CVE-2026-9828
  - CVE-2026-54512
  - CVE-2026-54513
  - CVE-2026-54514
  - CVE-2026-54515

Changes
The bundled Java version is Java 21.0.12, where we use the JRE from the Azul OpenJDK builds.
Advanced notice
- The AGP export (legacy) tool will be retired in a future version of the software.
- The legacy Workbench policy property 'run_on_workbench_when_server_is_available' will not be supported from version 27.0. The workbench_save_to_server policy property, available since version 25.0, should be used instead.
